string.text: Near a lit campfire, Body Health System limbs recover: temporary (green) fills first, then converts to permanent (blue). Default is 4x the usual Campfire limb-heal speed. Turn off other campfire limb-heal mods to avoid stacking.
Heal limbs while standing near a lit campfire.
Seconds between each limb heal tick. Default 7.5 (4x faster than a 30s Campfire mod).
